title: 鋼鉄の胎動：蒸気駆動の亡霊たち
author: ネオン 零

en.title: Steel Awakening: Steam-Driven Phantoms
en.premise: The neon light pierces my eyes. I'm just a hacker scavenging junk in the back alleys. One night, I hack and steal the blueprint of the "Final Train"—a moving impossibility built with obsolete "steam engines." It turns out to be the key to a top-secret project to upload all human consciousness. The pursuers are Atlas enforcers. Lost in the rain, I start running toward the terminus where mountains of iron roar.

zh.title: 钢铁胎动：蒸汽驱动的亡灵
zh.premise: 霓虹灯光刺痛双眼。我不过是个在小巷里搜寻废品的黑客。某天夜里，我通过黑客手段夺取了一份本该不复存在的“末班车”设计图，其内部竟组装着旧时代的“蒸汽机”。那是将全人类意识上传的极秘计划之钥匙。追兵是阿特拉斯的执行官。我混入雨中，朝着铁块轰鸣的终点站奔跑而去。
